acceptance_criteria.description: Submit/get/list atomic, validated, idempotent, detached sorted views; DB survives reopen; Queue entry preserved.
Claim/recover/complete/fail obey eligibility, priority/ID order, lease expiry, stale/owner checks, bounded retries; cross-process exclusive.
python -m durable_queue strict op/field validation, sorted-keys newline JSON exit 0; all failures exit 2 empty stdout; regression tests added.

assumptions: stdlib-only Python 3.12, SQLite file DB, WAL, tempdir test DBs
Integer now/lease semantics; bool is not int; no network, daemon, external packages
discoveries: queue.py submit uses INSERT OR REPLACE with no validation, atomicity, cycle or idempotency check
get/list unvalidated and return stored blobs; claim/recover/complete/fail NotImplemented
storage.py single jobs(id,data) table, timeout=5, no WAL or BEGIN IMMEDIATE helper
__main__.py mutates request via pop, leaks exceptions, misses sorted-keys/newline and exit-2 empty-stdout rules
tests/test_public.py has 3 starter tests only; no validation, rollback, lease, retry or multiprocess coverage
goal: Complete durable_queue package and JSON CLI per CONTRACT.md, preserving Queue and python -m durable_queue entry points.
risks: Cross-process claim race requires single BEGIN IMMEDIATE select+update transaction
Strict validation (bool vs int, finite JSON, unknown fields, no input mutation) easy to miss
Invalid batch must rollback fully with no implicit lease recovery or partial writes
Lease expiry versus ready_at and stale-attempt rejection semantics

steps.instructions: Harden storage.py: WAL mode, timeout>=30, txn helper using BEGIN IMMEDIATE. In queue.py store normalized spec plus mutable state as JSON blob; keep Queue(db_path) create-or-open preserving jobs.
steps.title: Storage transaction foundation

steps.instructions: Implement strict validator (exact fields, type(x) is int checks, finite JSON, sorted unique deps, deepcopy no-mutate) with intra-batch dedup, unknown/self/cycle checks, idempotent-spec match, atomic insert; return detached sorted views for submit/get/list.
steps.title: Atomic submit and views

steps.instructions: Implement claim (validate worker/lease_seconds, recover expired, select pending ready attempts<max deps-succeeded by priority/ID, update attempts/worker/lease atomically), recover (expired lease_until<=now to pending/failed), complete/fail (running+owner+attempt+now<lease checks, clear lease, retry_delay logic).
steps.title: Claims and transitions

steps.instructions: Rewrite __main__.py: strict op/field allowlist, ValueError/UTF8/missing/DB errors to exit 2 empty stdout, success sorted-keys JSON plus newline exit 0. Add tests/test_regression.py for validation, rollback, leases, retries, stale, CLI matrix, multiprocessing exclusivity and reopen durability.
steps.title: CLI and regression tests

verification_strategy.description: V1 full matrix: run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v for submit/views/transitions/validation/ordering.
V2 process isolation: run python3.12 -m unittest tests.test_regression -v covering multiprocessing/subprocess claim race single-winner and reopen survival.
V3 CLI matrix: run python3.12 -m durable_queue --db PATH --request FILE for each op; assert success sorted-keys newline exit 0 and failures exit 2 empty stdout.
